assertion.statement: Loki 3.0.0 adds dynamic client-side throttling to avoid object storage rate-limits, for GCS only.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: the evidence states only "(GCS only)" and names no configuration key, flag or setting that identifies GCS object storage usage, nor whether the throttling is enabled by default, so no exposure predicate can be grounded in the evidence; consequence: the evidence does not state whether the dynamic throttling applies automatically to GCS deployments or requires enabling via configuration, so the effect on an upgraded environment is unknown
